module.description: Module identifier (must be a valid Python identifier).

imports.description: Python imports injected into generated code. Use a string for 'import X' or an object for 'from X import A, B'.

oneOf.description: → from MODULE import A, B, C

url.description: Help URL applied to all blocks in this file.

blocks.description: Top-level (non-class) blocks in this category. __init__ is not valid here.

ClassDef.description: A class with Blockly blocks. Exactly one mode applies: singleton (one shared instance) or multiple (user-identified instances).

SingletonClassDef.description: A class with one shared instance. The variable name is fixed at author time (e.g. 'ds1302').

instance_name.description: Fixed Python variable name for the shared instance. Must be a valid identifier.

MultipleClassDef.description: A class where multiple named instances can exist, identified by a user-provided key.

method_ref.description: How method blocks refer to their instance. 'key_input' adds a numeric ID field; 'object_input' takes an instance block.

fn.description: Python function or method name (use __init__ for the constructor).

label.description: Block label shown in Blockly. Auto-derived from fn if omitted.

kind.description: Block shape: value returns a value; statement is a void action; hat starts a handler. Constructors are always statements.

inline.description: Render inputs inline (all on one row).

tooltip.description: Hover tooltip text shown in Blockly.

output_type.description: For value blocks: the primary Blockly output type (e.g. 'Color565', 'SPI'). Only blocks with matching output_type can snap into inputs typed accordingly.

supertype.description: Supertype of output_type. Only valid on value blocks. Declares that output_type is a subtype of supertype (e.g. Color565 <: Number), so the block can also snap into inputs that accept the supertype. Must be a known built-in or platform type.

allOf.description: output_type is only meaningful on kind: value blocks. If output_type is present, kind must be explicitly set to 'value'.
supertype requires both output_type and kind: value.

CategoryFunctionBlock.description: A function block at category level (not inside a class). __init__ is not valid here — constructors only make sense inside a class.

ParamDef.description: A parameter definition. Exactly one mode applies: value input (type/default), GPIO pin (pin_mode), legacy raw pin (pin), or dropdown (options). These are mutually exclusive alternatives — each maps to a distinct Blockly input kind.

ValueParamDef.description: A value input: accepts a connected block, optionally restricted by type.

type.description: Blockly type-check for the connected block. A single string (e.g. 'Number') or a list (['Number','SPI']) to accept multiple types. Built-in: Number, String, Boolean, Any. Custom values (e.g. Color565) restrict the slot to blocks with the matching output_type.

default.description: Default value rendered as a shadow block. Must be compatible with the declared type.

keyword.description: Emit as a keyword argument (name=value) in generated Python. Use for bus constructors like SPI(0, baudrate=..., sck=Pin(n)).

allOf.description: If type is Number and a default is given, the default must be a JSON number (not a string or boolean).
If type is Boolean and a default is given, the default must be a JSON boolean.
If type is String and a default is given, the default must be a JSON string.

PinParamDef.description: A GPIO pin input. Renders a pinout shadow block; wraps the number in Pin(n, Pin.IN/OUT) or Pin(n) in generated code.

pin_mode.description: GPIO direction. 'input' → Pin(n, Pin.IN); 'output' → Pin(n, Pin.OUT); 'any' → Pin(n).

default.description: Default pin number shown in the shadow block.

keyword.description: Emit as a keyword argument in generated Python.

LegacyPinParamDef.description: Legacy: renders a pinout shadow block and passes the raw pin integer (no Pin() wrapper). Prefer pin_mode for new blocks.

pin.description: Must be true. Marks this as a legacy raw-pin parameter.

default.description: Default pin number shown in the shadow block.

keyword.description: Emit as a keyword argument in generated Python.

DropdownParamDef.description: A dropdown field: renders as a fixed-choice selector in the block, not a value input.

value.description: Code value passed to the generated function call.
